# signature recovery address

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:signatureRecoveryAddress`](gmeow-signatureRecoveryAddress.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/signatureRecoveryAddress>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The blockchain address recovered from a signature's recovery data. Domain-free: may apply to [`CryptographicSignature`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md) or [`BlockchainAccount`](../classes/gmeow-BlockchainAccount.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; `?` -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:signatureRecoveryAddress`](gmeow-signatureRecoveryAddress.md) from `?` to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the address recovered from a signature's recovery data — the on-chain identity that produced an ECDSA/secp256k1 signature, linking a [`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md) to a [`gmeow:BlockchainAccount`](../classes/gmeow-BlockchainAccount.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a contract's deployment address ([`gmeow:contractAddress`](gmeow-contractAddress.md)) and avoid reading the recovered address as proof of a real-world identity — it proves key control, not who the person is (module boundaries).

### How to use

- Record the recovered address on the signature or account; the recovery computation runs in the solver layer, and binding the address to a real-world [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) requires an explicit identity-binding [`Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md).

### Examples

- ex:sig1 [`gmeow:signatureRecoveryAddress`](gmeow-signatureRecoveryAddress.md) "0xabc...".
